'''Thickston Deke''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|Military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Deke had orders to ambush and destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops intent on capturing the village of [[Chakton]].
